Aditya Music presents!
Experience the enchanting melodies of 'Virisina' in this romantic song from the movie 'Raajahyogam'. Sai Ronakh and Ankita Saha beautifully portray the chemistry of an endearing couple, while the soulful vocals of KS Harisankar and the melodious composition by Arun Muraleedharan create an ethereal ambiance.
